title: MoE路由是哈夫曼编码？发现思维链中的频率-多样性定律
summary: 本文发现MoE路由遵循哈夫曼编码原理，提出频率-多样性定律：模型为常见token分配稀疏专家，为复杂任务调用高多样性专家。识别了Qwen3.5中的冗余陷阱，并提出子集差异剪枝策略，消除功能冗余，释放潜在哈夫曼效率。建议下一代MoE应追求最小描述长度最优性。
summary_en: This paper discovers that MoE routing follows Huffman coding principles, proposing the Frequency-Diversity Law: models allocate sparse experts for common tokens and high-diversity experts for complex tasks. It identifies a redundancy trap in Qwen3.5 and proposes Subset Difference Pruning to eliminate functional duplicates, suggesting future MoEs should pursue MDL optimality.
